routeRule: UiSkin.texturePath uses original texture if dynamicAtlasManager.enabled, otherwise GoldFrame/HudPanel static maps; counts for both policies supplied because current runtime flag is not inferred from source. Workshop IDs have no existing atlas entry in either policy.

interpretation.inspectionCounter: PreparationResources.inspect.commonTextures/commonTextureBytes counts the shared Set, INCLUDING workshop once visited; it is not a count of common-only required textures or compressed network bytes.
interpretation.scope: Page waits common/workshop in parallel, then owned EquipmentArt. Common is session-memoised and prepared during rebuild, so later page entry does not reload all common textures. This asset audit does not measure time/network latency.
interpretation.reuseTool: src/cocos/tools/build-hud-render-assets.py already packs exact RGBA source pixels with copied edge gutters and per-rectangle byte equality assertions for HudPanel/GoldFrame. A workshop atlas would require an explicit new group and UiSkin route/region mapping; the existing tool has no workshop group. No atlas produced or runtime source changed.
